verdict.rationale: The evidence shows workflows are started or signaled programmatically through the Temporal Client, and Schedules start workflows at specific times. Neither is a declarative binding of app events, webhooks or queues to workflows. No documented mechanism fans one event out to many functions; these are developer building blocks and an adjacent time-based trigger, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a backend developer, events from my app, webhooks, or queues trigger workflows declaratively, and one event can fan out to many functions
